mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, total_price, payment_status, status FROM orders WHERE id = #{order_id}
SELECT id AS order_item_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity, fiscal_mxik_code, fiscal_package_code, vat_percent FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{order_id} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( order_id, user_id, provider, provider_transaction_id, amount, amount_tiyin, status, payme_time, payme_create_time ) VALUES ( #{order_id}, #{user_id}, 'PAYME', #{provider_transaction_id}, #{amount}, #{amount_tiyin}, 'CREATED', #{payme_time}, #{payme_create_time} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE provider = 'PAYME' AND provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = 'PAID', payme_perform_time = #{payme_perform_time} WHERE provider = 'PAYME' AND provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} AND status = 'CREATED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{order_id} AND provider = 'PAYME' AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING', 'PAID') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = #{status}, payme_cancel_time = #{payme_cancel_time}, payme_reason = #{payme_reason} WHERE provider = 'PAYME' AND provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PAID')
mapper.select: SELECT provider_transaction_id AS id, payme_time AS time, amount_tiyin AS amount, payme_create_time AS create_time, payme_perform_time AS perform_time, payme_cancel_time AS cancel_time, provider_transaction_id AS transaction, payme_reason AS reason, status, order_id FROM payments WHERE payme_create_time BETWEEN #{from_time} AND #{to_time} ORDER BY payme_create_time ASC
